threshold: no full table scan on a large table; every plan uses an index

results.description: Active project memories for a module, ordered for prompt assembly.
results.sql: SELECT * FROM memories WHERE project_id = ? AND valid_to IS NULL AND status != 'superseded' AND status != 'dormant' AND module = ? ORDER BY pinned DESC, reward_score DESC, created_at DESC
plans: SEARCH memories USING INDEX idx_memories_active (project_id=? AND module=? AND valid_to=?)
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

results.description: FTS5 BM25 candidate stream used by recall.
results.sql: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT m.*, bm25(memories_fts, 0.0, 10.0, 5.0, 1.0) AS rank FROM memories_fts f JOIN memories m ON m.id = f.id WHERE (m.project_id = ? OR m.project_id = 'global') AND memories_fts MATCH ? ORDER BY rank ASC LIMIT 50 ) ORDER BY rank ASC LIMIT 50
plans: CO-ROUTINE (subquery-1)
SCAN f VIRTUAL TABLE INDEX 0:M4
SEARCH m USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_memories_1 (id=?)
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY
SCAN (subquery-1)

results.description: Embedded-memory candidate scan used by the vector stream.
results.sql: SELECT * FROM memories WHERE (project_id = ? OR project_id = 'global') AND embedded = 1 AND embedding IS NOT NULL
plans: SEARCH memories USING INDEX idx_memories_embedded (project_id=? AND embedded=?)

results.sql: SELECT DISTINCT m.id FROM file_links fl JOIN memories m ON m.id = fl.memory_id WHERE m.project_id = ? AND fl.file_path IN (?, ?, ?)
plans: SEARCH m USING INDEX idx_memories_embedded (project_id=?)
SEARCH fl USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_file_links_1 (memory_id=? AND file_path=?)
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR DISTINCT

results.sql: SELECT ge.source_id, ge.target_id, ge.edge_type, ge.weight FROM graph_edges ge WHERE ge.project_id = ? AND (ge.source_id IN (?, ?) OR ge.target_id IN (?, ?))
plans: SEARCH ge USING INDEX idx_graph_edges_target (project_id=?)

results.description: Bi-temporal replay memory rows up to a timestamp.
results.sql: SELECT * FROM memories WHERE project_id = ? AND valid_from <= ? ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
plans: SEARCH memories USING INDEX idx_memories_embedded (project_id=?)
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

results.description: Raw-event rows up to a replay timestamp.
results.sql: SELECT * FROM raw_events WHERE project_id = ? AND created_at <= ? ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
plans: SEARCH raw_events USING INDEX idx_raw_events_project_created (project_id=? AND created_at<?)
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR LAST TERM OF ORDER BY

results.description: Open or newly resolved conflicts at a replay timestamp.
results.sql: SELECT * FROM memory_conflicts WHERE project_id = ? AND created_at <= ? AND (status = 'open' OR (resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND resolved_at > ?)) ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
plans: SEARCH memory_conflicts USING INDEX idx_conflicts_status (project_id=?)
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

results.description: Latest feedback rows for one memory.
results.sql: SELECT * FROM memory_feedback WHERE memory_id = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 3
plans: SEARCH memory_feedback USING INDEX idx_memory_feedback_memory (memory_id=?)

results.description: Case-insensitive branch lookup by project and name.
results.sql: SELECT id, project_id, name, base_snapshot_id, head_snapshot_id FROM memory_branches WHERE project_id = ? AND name = ? COLLATE NOCASE
plans: SEARCH memory_branches USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_memory_branches_2 (project_id=? AND name=?)
